*e* is the most magical concept in the universe.

Not every educated adult American can manipulate it properly, despite it being high school-level math.

I don't know when LLMs became capable of understanding the right time and place to use logs/exponentials, but they can.

I asked a coding agent to perform a calculation that requires conceptual understanding of Euler's number, using a purposefully imprecisely-presented question. I don't imagine that a mere *stochastic parrot* would be able to produce this answer.
